_README: Human decisions about App Store rejections. asc-preflight reads this and will
NOT submit over a self-withdrawn version without a CONFIRMED entry here.
This file exists because one thing is invisible to the App Store Connect API:
whether a REVIEWER wrote to us in Resolution Center before we pulled a
submission. DEVELOPER_REJECTED and an item state of REMOVED prove only that
the withdrawal was OURS, not why we made it. A person has to look and say so.
'status' is the whole point: only "confirmed" authorizes a submission.
"pending" records that the check has been ASKED FOR and not yet answered,
which is not the same thing and must never read as the same thing.
'withdrawnBuild' pins the entry to the build it is actually about, so a
confirmation can never be reused for a later withdrawal it never covered.
Quote a person only where they actually spoke. An attestation that
paraphrases someone into a confirmation they did not give is worse than no
attestation, because it reads as evidence.
